payload.name: eRank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use eRank in ChatGPT to research what shoppers search for on Etsy and how listings and shops compare. Look up statistics for one keyword or compare up to 20 at once, find related searches, see which listings rank for a keyword, and explore Trend Buzz keyword trends by marketplace, country, and period. You can also read the keyword lists you've saved in eRank.

For the Etsy shops connected to your eRank account, you can review the current shop's profile and sales ranks, browse its listings with eRank Listing Audit grades, analyze a listing's tags, and check recent sales for the competitor shops you track in eRank. You can also look up the public summary and active listings of any Etsy shop by its exact name.

eRank learning resources, news, product updates, and your account's plan and remaining usage are available too.

What you can access depends on your eRank account. Some data and daily search allowances vary by plan, and results say when data isn't available on your plan or a daily limit has been reached. Information about other shops is limited to public Etsy data and eRank's research data. It never includes their private orders, customers, or account details.

When you ask, the plugin can change which of your connected shops is active in eRank. It doesn't create, edit, publish, or delete Etsy listings, and it doesn't change Etsy shop settings.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用eRank研究买家在Etsy上的搜索内容，以及商品列表和店铺的对比情况。可查找单个关键词的统计数据或一次比较最多20个关键词，发现相关搜索词，查看某个关键词对应的商品列表，通过市场、国家和时间段探索Trend Buzz关键词趋势。您还可以查阅在eRank中保存的关键词列表。

对于与您的eRank账户连接的Etsy店铺，您可以查看当前店铺的资料和销售排名，浏览带有eRank清单审计评分的商品列表，分析商品的标签，并查看您跟踪的竞品店铺的近期销售情况。您还可以通过店铺的准确名称查询任意Etsy店铺的公开简介和活跃商品列表。

eRank还提供学习资料、新闻、产品更新信息，以及您账户的套餐和剩余使用量信息。

您可访问的内容取决于您的eRank账户类型。部分数据和每日搜索额度会根据套餐不同而有所差异，当数据在您的套餐中不可用或达到每日限额时，结果会明确提示。其他店铺的信息仅限公开的Etsy数据和eRank研究数据，不会包含其私人订单、客户或账户详情。

当您发起请求时，插件可更改eRank中已连接店铺的激活状态。该插件不会创建、编辑、发布或删除Etsy商品列表，也不会修改Etsy店铺设置。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Keyword statistics for one keyword or up to 20 at once, Related searches and top-ranking listings for a keyword, Trend Buzz keyword trends by marketplace and country, Saved eRank keyword lists, Current shop profile, sales ranks, and listings, Listing Audit grades and tag analysis, Recent sales for tracked competitor shops, Public summaries and listings for any Etsy shop, Active eRank shop selection, eRank learning resources, news, and product updates, Account plan and usage limits

payload.name: Local SEO Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Local SEO Data brings live local search data for any business and market into your conversations.

Check who ranks in Google's local pack, Maps and organic results for a keyword and city; pull a business's Google Business Profile, reviews and Q&A; run local SEO, citation and reputation audits; research local keywords and search volume; compare competitors and backlinks; scan rankings across a geographic grid; and measure how often AI search answers mention a brand. Apple Maps and Bing results are included too.

Built for SEO agencies, marketers and local businesses. Requires a Local SEO Data account; you sign in with it when you connect. Every tool is read-only: Local SEO Data looks up public search and listing data and never changes your Google Business Profile or any other account.
payload.longDescription:
Local SEO Data将任何企业及市场的实时本地搜索数据融入您的对话。

查看针对关键词和城市的Google本地包、地图及自然结果排名；提取企业Google商业资料、评论及问答内容；执行本地SEO、引用资料和声誉审计；研究本地关键词及搜索量；对比竞争对手和反向链接；跨地理网格扫描排名；并衡量AI搜索回答提及品牌频率。Apple Maps和Bing结果也包含在内。

专为SEO代理机构、营销人员和本地企业打造。需要Local SEO Data账户；连接时需使用该账户登录。所有工具均为只读模式：Local SEO Data仅查询公开的搜索和列表数据，不会修改您的Google商业资料或其他任何账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check Google local pack, Maps and organic rankings, Pull Google Business Profiles, reviews and Q&A, Run local SEO, citation and reputation audits, Research local keywords and search volume, Compare competitors and backlinks, Scan rankings across a geographic grid, Measure brand visibility in AI answers, Look up Apple Maps and Bing listings

payload.name: Rankium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rankium is a visibility intelligence platform for websites and online businesses. It lets users connect and inspect their own search, analytics, market, directory, backlink, and technical-site data from sources such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Bing Webmaster Tools, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and optional visibility providers. Use Rankium to list accessible website projects and companies, read underlying provider measurements, review the Rankium Visibility Score, inspect evidence-grounded reports, action queues, prioritized visibility roadmaps, and directory coverage. Rankium preserves source-specific freshness and reporting semantics rather than treating first-party measurements and third-party estimates as interchangeable. Some refresh and scan operations may contact connected providers and consume Rankium plan quota; read-only tools use data already available to the authenticated Rankium account. Rankium does not publish or modify the user's website through these plugin tools.
payload.longDescription: Rankium 是面向网站和在线企业的可见性智能平台。它允许用户连接并检查来自 Google Search Console、Google Analytics 4、Bing Webmaster Tools、DataForSEO、Firecrawl 以及可选的可见性服务提供商等来源的搜索、分析、市场、目录、反向链接和技术站点数据。通过 Rankium 可以列出可访问的网站项目和企业，查看底层服务商的测量数据，查阅 Rankium 可见性评分，检查基于证据的报告、操作队列、优先级可见性路线图和目录覆盖范围。Rankium 会保留原始数据源的更新频率和报告语义，而非将第一方测量数据与第三方估算数据视为可互换。部分刷新和扫描操作可能需要联系已连接的服务商并消耗 Rankium 计划配额；只读工具则使用已认证 Rankium 账户可用的数据。Rankium 不会通过这些插件工具发布或修改用户网站。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read website visibility data, Review search and analytics signals, Inspect visibility scores and reports, Prioritize visibility improvements, Check directory coverage

payload.name: 3RD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
3RD measures how visible your brand is when people ask AI assistants about your market. Connect your 3RD account to ask, in plain language:

- How visible is our brand right now, and how has that changed?
- How do we rank against the competitors we track?
- Which websites and pages do the assistants cite when they answer?
- Which questions do we lack content for?
- What should we do next, according to our plan and the recommended tasks?

The plugin reads the brands, prompts, markets and competitors you already monitor in 3RD; it only shows data your account can access. Numbers cover a stated period, usually the last 30 days. The plugin only reads; it never changes your account.

Monitoring is set up in the 3RD app; new brands and prompts need their first answers collected before results appear.
payload.longDescription:
3RD可衡量当人们向AI助手咨询您的市场时，您的品牌有多大的可见性。
连接您的3RD账户，用自然语言提问：

- 我们的品牌当前可见性如何，这种可见性发生了什么变化？
- 我们在追踪的竞争对手中排名如何？
- 助手回答时引用了哪些网站和页面？
- 我们在哪些问题上缺乏相关内容？
- 根据我们的计划和推荐任务，下一步该做什么？

插件会读取您已在3RD中监控的品牌、提示语、市场和竞争对手；它仅展示您账户可访问的数据。
数据覆盖指定时间段，通常是最近30天。
插件仅用于读取数据，不会更改您的账户。

监控功能在3RD应用中设置；新品牌和提示语需要先收集首次回答后结果才会显示。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Report AI visibility for a brand, Compare a brand with its competitors over time, Show which sources AI assistants cite, Find questions the brand lacks content for, Show the playbook and recommended next tasks

payload.name: DataFluxor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect DataFluxor to research Google search results and inspect public websites from ChatGPT. Tools cover organic SERP results, autocomplete suggestions, index checks, page metadata, bounded technical SEO crawls, SERP volatility, competitor keyword comparisons, AI Overview visibility, and retained runs. Sign in to your own DataFluxor workspace with OAuth. An existing paid plan and credits are required; each paid tool states its credit cost. Results come from public search and web pages requested by the user. Tool availability follows the workspace plan and permissions.
payload.longDescription:
将DataFluxor连接至ChatGPT，用于研究Google搜索结果并检查公共网站。
工具涵盖自然搜索结果、自动补全建议、索引检测、页面元数据、有限技术SEO爬取、SERP波动性、竞争对手关键词对比、AI摘要可见性及已保存的爬取任务。
通过OAuth登录您自己的DataFluxor工作区。
需要有效的付费计划和信用额度；每个付费工具会标明其信用消耗。
结果来源于用户请求的公共搜索和网页内容。
工具可用性取决于工作区计划和权限配置。

payload.name: Egantic
payload.description: 将Bol的市场数据纳入你的AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Egantic is een analysetool voor verkopers op bol.com: het levert marktdata en analyses over je eigen producten. Elke nacht meet Egantic hoe je producten op bol.com staan: zoekposities per zoekwoord, zichtbaarheid, prijs tegenover concurrenten, reviews, zoekvolumes, advertentiedruk in je markt en de weekanalyse per product. Met deze plugin stel je daar vragen over in gewone taal en krijg je cijfers met meetdag en bron. Alles leest opgeslagen metingen van je eigen Egantic-werkruimte; de plugin wijzigt niets bij bol.com en niets in Egantic. Bedoeld voor verkopers op bol.com met een Egantic-account met minstens één gevolgd product.
payload.longDescription: Egantic是bol.com卖家的分析工具，提供关于您自己产品的市场数据和分析。每晚，Egantic会监测您的产品在bol.com上的表现：按关键词的搜索位置、可见性、与竞争对手的价格对比、评论、搜索量、市场广告压力以及按产品每周分析。通过此插件，您可以以自然语言提出相关问题，并获得带有测量日期和来源的数据。所有数据均来自您自己的Egantic工作区存储的测量记录；插件不会修改bol.com或Egantic中的任何内容。适用于在bol.com上拥有Egantic账户并至少跟踪一个产品的卖家。

payload.name: Petalie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Petalie gets the public numbers of a TikTok account from its username or profile link. It returns the profile (followers, following, total likes, post count), the newest 20 posts with their views, likes, comments, shares, length and caption, and numbers computed from them: the typical views per post, the best and lowest post, how often the account posts, engagement per 1,000 views, and which posts appear to be paid promotion. It adds short notes on what stands out in those numbers and a link to the account's page on petalie.ai.

Use it for your own account or for another public account you want to understand. It reads public data only: it does not watch or analyze the videos themselves, needs no password, has no access to private analytics, and never posts or changes anything. TikTok only, with a daily limit of reads per person.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Get a public TikTok account's profile and recent post numbers, Compare an account's best post with its typical one, Summarize posting frequency and engagement per 1,000 views

payload.name: MarginEdge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MarginEdge is restaurant back-office software that processes invoices, tracks food costs and inventory, and connects to POS and accounting systems. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your MarginEdge data, so owners, operators, chefs and accounting teams can get answers in plain language instead of building reports by hand.

With it, ChatGPT can:
- Look up invoices by date range, vendor or location, down to individual line items
- Track what you pay for a product over time and compare prices across vendors
- Review recipes, ingredients and plate costs, and how recipe costs have changed
- Pull inventory counts and values, and the count sheets behind them
- Read sales and profit-and-loss reports for a single location or a group of locations
- Browse your product catalog, categories, vendors and vendor items

Example questions:
- "Which products went up the most in price from our produce vendor this quarter?"
- "What did we spend on food by category at our downtown location last month?"
- "Which menu recipes are over their target plate cost?"
- "Compare sales across our locations for last week."

Works well for multi-location groups: ChatGPT can roll data up across locations or drill into one.

How it works: sign in with your MarginEdge account. ChatGPT sees only the restaurants and data your account already has access to, and it can't create, change or delete anything in MarginEdge. Access requires a MarginEdge Admin or Franchisee Admin role.
payload.longDescription:
MarginEdge是餐厅后台软件，可处理发票、跟踪食材成本和库存，并连接POS系统和会计系统。该插件为ChatGPT提供对MarginEdge数据的只读访问权限，使店主、运营人员、主厨和财务团队能够通过自然语言获取答案，而非手动制作报表。

通过该插件，ChatGPT可实现以下功能：
- 按日期范围、供应商或门店查找发票，精确到单个明细项
- 跟踪某产品随时间推移的采购价格，并对比不同供应商的价格
- 查看食谱、原料和餐盘成本，以及食谱成本的变化情况
- 提取库存数量和价值，以及对应的库存清单
- 查阅单个门店或多个门店的销售和损益报告
- 浏览产品目录、分类、供应商及供应商商品信息

示例问题：
- "本季度从我们的农产品供应商处价格上涨最多的商品有哪些？"
- "上个月我们在市中心门店的食材分类支出是多少？"
- "哪些菜单食谱的餐盘成本超过目标值？"
- "对比我们各门店上周的销售情况。"

适用于多门店集团：ChatGPT可跨门店汇总数据或深入查看单个门店数据。

使用方式：通过MarginEdge账户登录。
ChatGPT仅能查看您账户已有的餐厅和数据，且无法在MarginEdge中创建、修改或删除任何内容。
访问权限需要MarginEdge管理员或特许经营管理员角色。

payload.name: AVA Golf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AVA Golf is a golf intelligence system. It brings together your rounds and practice from the devices and apps you already use, measures every shot in strokes gained, and builds a personal list of priorities: what's costing you the most strokes and what to practice next.

This plugin lets you ask ChatGPT about your own AVA Golf data in plain language: your rounds and practice sessions, strokes gained by phase, club distances and dispersion, your Handicap Index® history, how your recent rounds compare with earlier ones, and your priorities with the practice work behind each one.

Ask things like "Where am I losing the most strokes?", "How far do I really hit my 7-iron?" or "What should I work on before Saturday?"

The plugin only reads. It never changes your data, and it reads only the account you sign in with. You choose what to share on the AVA Golf consent screen, and you can revoke access at any time under Settings → Connections → Connected apps. Requires an active AVA Golf membership.
payload.longDescription:
AVA Golf是一款高尔夫智能系统。
它整合你已使用的设备和应用中的回合和练习数据，通过杆数收益量化每杆表现，并生成个人优先改进清单：列出对你影响最大的杆数流失点，以及下一步的练习重点。

该插件允许你用自然语言向ChatGPT查询个人AVA Golf数据：包括你的回合记录和练习课程、各阶段杆数收益情况、球杆距离与偏差数据、差点指数®历史记录、近期回合与过往回合的对比分析，以及每个改进重点对应的练习内容。

你可以提问如「我在哪里损失最多杆数？」「我的7号铁杆实际能打多远？」「周六之前我该重点练什么？」等问题。

该插件仅具备数据读取权限。
不会修改任何数据，且仅访问你当前登录的账户数据。
你可在AVA Golf的同意页面自主选择分享内容，也可随时通过设置→连接→已连接应用页面撤销权限。
需要有效的AVA Golf会员资格。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read your rounds, practice sessions and shots, Read strokes gained, club distances and Handicap Index® history, Read your trends and practice priorities

payload.description: 向数据提问，获取答案，并采取行动。
payload.summaryOriginal: Ask, answer, act on your data.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Fospha's daily, full-funnel measurement into ChatGPT, so you can use natural language to understand the impact of every channel across everywhere you sell without dashboards or manual reports.
payload.longDescription: 将Fospha的每日全漏斗数据接入ChatGPT，这样您就可以通过自然语言理解每个销售渠道的影响，而无需依赖仪表盘或手动报告。

payload.name: SerialHunt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SerialHunt tells you whether a US bill is worth keeping, from the serial number printed on it.

Give it a serial and it reads the note the way a collector would: the Federal Reserve Bank, the series (worked out from the serial when it can be), and every fancy pattern in the eight digits, such as a radar, repeater, ladder, solid, binary, birthday or low serial, each with its exact odds counted across all 100,000,000 possible serials.

For a star note, the replacement note marked with a star in place of the last letter, it finds the exact print run the serial came from in the Bureau of Engraving and Printing's production figures and says how many star notes shared it. A star is only as scarce as its run, so this is the number that decides whether to keep one. It also says when a serial falls in a stretch the press skipped, so no such note was ever issued.

Ask which star notes had the smallest print runs for a denomination, series or Federal Reserve Bank, what a pattern means and how rare it is, or which series the figures cover. The figures run from Series 1963 to the current series and update weekly from the Bureau's monthly reports, through the uspapermoney.info archive for older series.

SerialHunt gives no prices and makes no authenticity claims, on purpose: no price guide for US paper money can be licensed, and a serial cannot show whether a note is genuine. Every answer links to the same result on the SerialHunt web lookup. Every tool is read-only and no account is needed.

payload.name: ChartGlow
payload.description: 从您的数据生成动态图表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn your data into animated Bar Race, Line Race, Bubble Race and Treemap Race charts. Bring your own dataset or ask ChatGPT to retrieve and verify sources, then keep units and attribution with your chart. Adjust chart type, theme and aspect ratio directly in ChatGPT. Open the ChartGlow editor to add country flags and images, customize the design, save your project and export MP4 video. Two published Explore examples are also available. Chart creation does not automatically save a project or export a video. A ChartGlow account is needed for the native save and export workflow.
payload.longDescription: 将您的数据转化为动态条形图竞速、折线图竞速、气泡图竞速和树状图竞速图表。使用您自己的数据集，或让ChatGPT检索并验证来源，然后在图表中保留单位和来源标注。直接在ChatGPT中调整图表类型、主题和宽高比。打开ChartGlow编辑器添加国家旗帜和图片，自定义设计，保存项目并导出MP4视频。还提供两个已发布的探索示例。图表创建不会自动保存项目或导出视频。要使用原生的保存和导出工作流，需要ChartGlow账户。

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Feed Optimization
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD.AI for Feed Optimization helps merchants and ecommerce teams analyze connected Google Merchant Center accounts, audit Shopping feeds, diagnose disapprovals, optimize product data, and understand Shopping performance.

Use it to:

• Find products that are disapproved or not eligible to serve and prioritize account-level and item-level issues by severity and affected product count.

• Audit feed quality and get recommendations for product titles, descriptions, identifiers, categories, images, pricing, availability, and other attributes exposed in Merchant Center.

• Inspect product details and approval status, then monitor whether fixes made in the source platform or Merchant Center are reflected by Google.

• Analyze clicks, impressions, CTR, conversions, and conversion value by product, brand, category, date, week, or marketing method.

• Compare prices with Google Shopping benchmarks, review competitive visibility, and inspect linked Google Ads accounts.

It pairs especially well with Shopify stores that sync their product catalog to Google Merchant Center. Use HYPD.AI to analyze the Merchant Center version of the Shopify catalog, diagnose feed or synchronization issues, and decide which product data to improve in Shopify. Alongside Shopify access, it can help connect catalog changes with Merchant Center status and Shopping performance.

HYPD.AI is read-only. It supports feed auditing, optimization planning, troubleshooting, and monitoring, but it cannot edit Shopify products, change feed attributes or prices, resubmit feeds, resolve disapprovals, link accounts, or modify Merchant Center settings. It explains findings and recommends the next steps for you to apply in Shopify, your feed source, or Merchant Center.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD.AI for Feed Optimization帮助商家和电商团队分析连接的Google商家中心账户，审核购物数据源，诊断未获批准的产品，优化产品数据并了解购物表现。

可用于：

• 查找未获批准或无法投放的产品，根据严重程度和影响产品数量对账户级和商品级问题进行优先级排序。

• 审核数据源质量并获取产品标题、描述、标识符、分类、图片、定价、库存及其他在商家中心展示属性的优化建议。

• 检查产品详情和审批状态，监控源平台或商家中心的修复操作是否被Google体现。

• 按商品、品牌、分类、日期、周或营销方式分析点击量、展示量、点击率、转化量及转化价值。

• 对比价格与Google购物基准，查看竞争可见性并检查关联的Google Ads账户。

该工具特别适合将产品目录同步到Google Merchant Center的Shopify店铺。
使用HYPD.AI分析Merchant Center中的Shopify目录版本，诊断商品目录或同步问题，并决定在Shopify中需要优化哪些产品数据。
除Shopify访问权限外，还能帮助将目录变更与Merchant Center状态及Shopping表现进行关联。

HYPD.AI为只读模式。
它支持商品目录审计、优化计划制定、故障排查和监控功能，但无法编辑Shopify产品、更改目录属性或价格、重新提交目录、解决未批准项、链接账户或修改Merchant Center设置。
它会解释检测结果并为您推荐在Shopify、目录源或Merchant Center需要执行的下一步操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Audit product feeds, Read Shopping performance

payload.name: Outlook Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Outlook email for work conversations: search messages, summarize threads, draft replies, manage follow-ups.
payload.longDescription: 用于工作沟通的 Microsoft Outlook 邮件：搜索邮件、总结对话串、起草回复并管理后续跟进。

payload.name: Slack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up chats and messages
payload.longDescription: 查找聊天和消息

payload.name: Superhuman Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Superhuman Mail to build powerful workflows across Gmail, Outlook, and Google Calendar. Search your inbox and calendar, summarize what matters, draft AI replies in your voice, check read statuses, prepare for your day, send emails or schedule events, and manage multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Superhuman Mail，在 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google Calendar 之间构建强大的工作流程。搜索收件箱和日历、总结重要内容、以你的口吻拟写 AI 回复、查看已读状态、为一天的安排做准备、发送邮件或安排活动，并管理多个 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户。

payload.name: Werify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. They can find a conversation, read its transcript a page at a time (voice notes included, as text), search inside it and list its attachments. With the user's approval it can also act: send one confirmed text message, connect a WhatsApp number by pairing code, preview how far back a chat's earlier history reaches and how much of it each window would bring in, start or stop capture, and bring in one window the user explicitly approved. Werify is prepaid and the account is funded on werify.app; nothing is sold, priced or paid for through this app.
payload.longDescription: Werify在ChatGPT内为用户创建专属的WhatsApp归档——包含用户从聊天导出文件中导入的对话，或通过连接的号码捕获的对话。用户可以查找特定对话，逐页查看文字记录（含语音备忘录的文本形式），在对话内搜索内容并查看附件列表。在获得用户授权后，该工具还可执行操作：发送一条确认过的短信、通过配对码连接WhatsApp号码、预览聊天历史可追溯的范围及各窗口可加载的内容、启动或停止捕获功能，并导入用户明确批准的单个窗口内容。Werify采用预付费模式，账户资金通过werify.app充值；该应用内不涉及任何商品销售、定价或支付流程。

payload.name: Teams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Teams workplace chat and collaboration: search messages, summarize threads, send replies, manage Planner tasks.
payload.longDescription: Microsoft Teams 办公聊天与协作：搜索消息、总结讨论串、发送回复并管理 Planner 任务。

payload.name: Hostinger Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hostinger Mail helps users discover mailbox operations, inspect mailboxes and folders, read or search messages, send email, and manage message or webhook state in their authenticated Hostinger Mail account through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT，用户可以在经过身份验证的 Hostinger Mail 账号中查找邮箱操作、检查邮箱和文件夹、阅读或搜索邮件、发送电子邮件，以及管理邮件或 webhook 状态。

payload.name: Zoom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zoom connects Codex to Zoom meeting context through the Zoom app connector and provides developer workflows for planning, building, debugging, and reviewing Zoom integrations across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, WebSockets, bots, and automation use cases.
payload.longDescription: Zoom 通过 Zoom 应用连接器将 Zoom 会议背景连接到 Codex，并为规划、构建、调试和审核 Zoom 集成提供开发工作流，涵盖 API、SDK、webhook、WebSocket、机器人和自动化场景。

payload.name: Mailopoly Inbox
payload.description: 搜索并发送邮件和消息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailopoly brings supported email accounts and messaging services into one unified inbox. Connect Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, or a compatible IMAP mailbox. Search across connected accounts, read complete emails and attachment text, catch up on new mail, and draft or send email from a connected account.

Mailopoly analyzes connected email to surface priorities and extract tasks, meetings and events, invoices and bills with amounts and due dates, and parcel deliveries. Organize messages with smart lists, troubleshoot syncing and reconnection, and receive an optional daily briefing.

Mailopoly also supports authorized connections to Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Messages from connected services appear alongside email, can be searched in the same inbox, and can be answered in their original service.

A Mailopoly account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Mailopoly 将支持的电子邮件账户和消息服务整合到一个统一收件箱中。连接 Gmail、Google Workspace、Outlook、Microsoft 365、iCloud Mail、Yahoo Mail 或兼容的 IMAP 邮箱。搜索已连接账户、阅读完整邮件和附件文本、查看新邮件，也可以从已连接账户起草或发送邮件。

Mailopoly 会分析已连接的邮件，提取优先事项、任务、会议和活动、带金额与到期日的发票和账单，以及包裹配送信息。你可以通过智能列表整理消息、排查同步和重新连接问题，并选择接收每日简报。

Mailopoly 还支持授权连接 Slack、Microsoft Teams、WhatsApp、TikTok、Facebook 和 Instagram。来自已连接服务的消息会与电子邮件一起显示，可在同一收件箱中搜索，并能在原服务中回复。

需要 Mailopoly 账户。

payload.name: Brevo
payload.description: 访问营销活动与联系人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Brevo to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. ChatGPT can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. ChatGPT will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Brevo 后，你可以用日常语言分析电子邮件营销活动的表现和 A/B 测试结果、查找联系人并探索受众细分，全程无需离开当前对话。ChatGPT 还可以生成 HTML 邮件模板、起草电子邮件营销活动和 SMS 营销活动，并直接保存到你的 Brevo 账户，供你审核后再发送。ChatGPT 绝不会代你发送或安排电子邮件营销活动，也不会代你删除任何内容。所有 Brevo 套餐均可使用。
